picks.title: Dewey Data (Yale subscription)
picks.why: Look for a consistent monthly point-of-interest visits product covering downtown in 2019–2023.
picks.limitations: Specific vendor coverage, historical availability, sample stability and Yale license terms must be confirmed; visits are not street pedestrian counts.

resolution.label: good
resolution.reason: Reported by address or point, finer than your town or place unit

picks.yale_note: Register at app.deweydata.io with a Yale email; approval can take up to 48 hours. Check the Library list of datasets available at Yale.

picks.title: LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics (LODES)
picks.why: Describe workplace employment and commuting context near downtown.
picks.limitations: Annual workplace counts are not monthly pedestrian traffic and do not establish pandemic causation.

resolution.label: good
resolution.reason: Reported by block, finer than your town or place unit

picks.title: TIGER/Line and cartographic boundary files
picks.why: Use census boundaries to inspect how reporting units intersect downtown.
picks.limitations: Census boundaries do not define downtown or directly measure foot traffic.

picks.title: American Community Survey 5-year estimates
picks.why: Provide broad local commuting and demographic context.
picks.limitations: Overlapping five-year estimates blur year-to-year pandemic changes and do not measure visits.

resolution.label: good
resolution.reason: Reported by block group, finer than your town or place unit

methods.name: Season-matched recovery index
methods.why: Divide each month's visits by the same month in 2019 and multiply by 100.

methods.name: Coverage and boundary sensitivity
methods.why: Check stable device sampling, locations and downtown boundaries; compare with fixed pedestrian counters if available.

next_steps: Ask Town Green District for its historical pedestrian counter series and metadata for 2019–2023.
Confirm Dewey product and Yale license cover each year and a consistent set of downtown locations.
Compare matched months and report uncertainty and any changes in measurement.
